title: A historic change in Moldovan sport: the Table Tennis Federation changes its leadership and Statute by absolute majority vote
body_html:
Chișinău, 18 May 2025 — A landmark moment for Moldovan sport took place recently with the General Assembly of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova. The event, seen as a real step forward in consolidating and reforming the national sports movement, brought together 73 members and delegates from across the country — an unprecedented turnout in the Federation’s recent history.

At the meeting, participants decided by absolute majority vote to change the Federation’s leadership and to amend the organisation’s Statute. The vote reflects a united and strongly consolidated position of the sporting community, which showed determination and cohesion in the face of the need to modernise decision-making and make it more transparent.

The new decisions promise tangible benefits in the short term. The new leadership’s priorities include reviving national competitions, supporting young talent, attracting external funding and developing sports infrastructure dedicated to table tennis.

“This is a historic moment that marks the start of a new stage for table tennis in the Republic of Moldova. The changes adopted are not merely formal; they set a clear direction towards professionalism, fairness and better international results”, said several members of the sporting community present at the event.

Through this unifying action, the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova is aligning itself with international good practice and taking on a more active role in promoting the sport nationwide. The overall mood was one of hope and enthusiasm, a sign that Moldovan sport can be reborn through the will and commitment of those who represent it.
